policy_cards.title: Successful operations must update persistent state
policy_cards.requirement: Successful state-changing operations must update the relevant persisted state or ledger field.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: A function can return success while leaving the system in an inconsistent state.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Successful operations must update the relevant persisted state before returning success.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec explicitly state which state changes must happen after success?
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: A function can return success while leaving the system in an inconsistent state.
audit_questions: Does the spec explicitly state which state changes must happen after success?
policy_cards.example_failure: A function can return success while leaving the system in an inconsistent state.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Successful operations must update the relevant persisted state before returning success.

policy_cards.title: Invalid inputs must fail safely
policy_cards.requirement: Invalid, missing, malformed, or unsupported inputs must fail without changing protected state.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Unchecked invalid inputs can drive unsafe or undefined behavior.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Invalid or unsupported inputs must return an error and must not mutate state.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec say how invalid inputs are rejected?
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Unchecked invalid inputs can drive unsafe or undefined behavior.
audit_questions: Does the spec say how invalid inputs are rejected?
policy_cards.example_failure: Unchecked invalid inputs can drive unsafe or undefined behavior.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Invalid or unsupported inputs must return an error and must not mutate state.
